releases.name: Qualify one truthful provider-usage tray journey
releases.consumer: A Windows operator viewing one enabled AI provider's usage in the existing tray app.
releases.outcome: The operator can open the tray and identify one enabled provider's current usage or an explicit stale/unavailable state.
releases.minimumScope: Existing Windows app, one selected provider/source and a read-only settings/refresh journey; no new provider or cookie extraction.
dependencies: Existing fork/runtime owner; exact selected app/provider source and privacy-safe credentials handling.
acceptance: Usage/identity/source belong to the chosen provider; empty/error/stale state never borrows another provider's account.
Known successful, expired/unavailable and partial-provider fixtures produce truthful bounded outcomes with no secret logs.
Exact source/build/installed native artifact matches actual tray/settings interaction; native geometry/theme/accessibility proof is separate from frontend tests.
releases.sourceBuildAndSelection: Existing Rust/Tauri/frontend checks and native owner route qualify an exact artifact; do not invent coverage floors or run the release installer.
releases.rollback: Retain prior immutable app/config selection and secure credential storage; restore only owned settings/artifact with readback.
releases.ownerOrGap: Existing repository/product/source and runtime custodians; current acknowledgement or lifecycle decision remains an explicit gap.

releases.name: Qualify a second provider and safe account/source switching
releases.consumer: A Windows operator viewing one enabled AI provider's usage in the existing tray app.
releases.outcome: The operator can switch selected sources/accounts without stale data or identity crossing providers.
releases.minimumScope: One additional existing provider and account switch, explicit refresh/error behavior and provider-local state.
acceptance: ProviderA/B concurrent refresh and source changes preserve identity and result-generation boundaries.
Malformed/expired/unsupported source returns a clear outcome; diagnostics stay value-free.
Tray/float-bar/settings native interactions on the exact candidate and regression of U0 are observed.
releases.sourceBuildAndSelection: Existing provider-state owner and reviewed UI primitives; ordinary Rust/Tauri/frontend tests plus native proof after separately approved selection.
releases.rollback: Restore previous provider/source setting and immutable artifact without deleting credentials or unrelated account state.
releases.ownerOrGap: Existing repository/product/source and runtime custodians; current acknowledgement or lifecycle decision remains an explicit gap.

releases.name: Qualify controlled update and installed CLI integration
releases.consumer: A Windows operator viewing one enabled AI provider's usage in the existing tray app.
releases.outcome: The operator can upgrade the chosen app/CLI and use one local read-only consumer with verified rollback.
releases.minimumScope: Exact installer/portable checksum and existing local CLI contract; no upstream release, global distribution or broad provider activation.
acceptance: Artifact identity/checksum and exact app/CLI selection match the accepted fork/upstream decision.
Install/upgrade/uninstall and one local consumer preserve settings and truthful provider states.
Rollback restores exact prior binding/configuration; cookie import remains opt-in and no source listing proves successful delivery.
releases.sourceBuildAndSelection: Existing release/runtime owner applies the actual supported packaging/versioning policy; source documentation alone is not current release evidence.
releases.rollback: Retain the previous immutable package/config backup and prove restoration of exact selected app/CLI behavior.
releases.ownerOrGap: Existing repository/product/source and runtime custodians; current acknowledgement or lifecycle decision remains an explicit gap.
